title: Rubbermaid Brilliance Tritan Plastic Food Storage Containers BPA Free Airtight Lids Ideal for Lunch Meal Prep & Leftovers Set of 5 (3.2 Cup)

reviews.title: Rubbermaid Brilliance products are excellent.
reviews.body: Rubbermaid has a good product reputation, and these Brilliance storage containers are no exception.First, even though Rubbermaid states that these containers are dishwasher safe, I never put my plastic items in the dishwasher.  What does "dishwasher safe" mean or imply?I personally believe the water temperature in a dishwasher is far too high and will alter the product integrity (e.g., the excessively high water temperatures can, over time, cause the plastic to become brittle, and make it subject to cracking - or - cause the container to warp, or change the integrity of the rubber-like gasket thus changing the the ability these containers to seal as tightly as it should.) Thus, I feel my time is well spent hand-washing these containers. I have not experienced any cracking, warping, or problems sealing these containers.Given that this product actually performed better than expected, my son wanted me to find a similar, yet larger container to store leftover chili. He wanted round containers to hold approximately 8 to 9 cups of liquid. Bingo, Rubbermaid Brilliance has those also.Oh, BTW, I also do not put any pots, pans, or roasters in the dishwasher! My father, a chef, told me to wash them only in a dishwasher if I wanted to shorten the lifespan of my very expensive cookware.I look at handwashing my Rubbermaid Brilliance storage containers with the same thought in mind. A little Dawn liquid dish soap, and these containers function as if they were new.These are excellent food storage containers. And because they are made of clear plastic and come in a variety of sizes, they can be used in the pantry to store baking goods (such as flour and sugar) and dry foods (like rice, cereal, and beans). In fact, I can think of hundreds of uses for these containers, such as sewing and crafts. I also bet men could use them on their workbench (for nuts, bolts, screws, etc.).

reviews.body: This is a great set! I very much like the locking tops that seal securely to keep out "critters". The range of sizes makes this a great starter set and I will be buying a few more individual pieces to meet my needs.

reviews.title: No more spaghetti sauce crime scenes
reviews.body: I bought these because I was tired of my cheap food containers turning permanently orange after a single round of leftover pasta.These things are elite. The seal is so tight I'm pretty sure they are airtight enough for space travel. They look exactly like glass but won't shatter when my clumsy hands inevitably drop them, and they actually survive the microwave without melting or staining.Highly recommend if you want to finally feel like a fully functioning adult when you open your fridge.

reviews.author: Tyler W.

reviews.title: Best food storage containers!
reviews.body: I love all the Rubbermaid Brilliance BPA-Free Food Storage containers that I have purchased. They are lightweight and sturdy. They don’t hold odors. They clean easily. I don’t have a dishwasher so I can’t say how well they do in that environment, but they do easily handwash. I would suggest making sure you clean up, around, over, under and through the seals. They have a little area inside the seal where oils or food bits can get stuck.They are very easy to use but sometimes the seal is so strong, it’s a bit hard to open, but you will never smell your food odors in the fridge again. That makes them especially great for foods that are spicy.They do well with hot and cold foods. I have not used them in the freezer yet.I have been using various sizes for over a year and none of them have degraded. I do not use them in the microwave, as I only use tempered glass or Corelle in the microwave.I buy them in bulk when they are on sale. Worth the money.

reviews.title: Excellent product
reviews.body: My daughter loves this set of storage containers. They’re  crystal clear , so it is very easy to see what is being stored. The food feels “cleaner” too, when the containers aren’t cloudy and opaque, and the food is fresher. This was a Christmas gift for my daughter and she is very happy with them. These containers are well worth the few extra dollars they cost to not have to replace them when cheaper ones get smelly and scratched up. I ordered a dozen of these in various sizes for her.
